answer: Resist Sybils with a summit ladder: every identity starts at base camp and climbs only by finishing qualitatively different, independently verified jobs - code, reasoning, tool use - each rung a pearl earned at depth, not bought in bulk. A farm must pay the full climb for every fake, since rungs cannot be shared or copied across identities. Random gale audits then sweep the ladder, re-testing a sample of climbers; fakes that crammed the climb fail, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps its credential cheaply.
